title: Reference (teacher capture)
description: A reference is NOT a model — it is one capture of reference logits: (artifact, panel, stack, precision). This granularity is deliberate. Two numbers computed against 'BF16' are still incomparable if one teacher was captured in fp32 on vLLM over a 25-window panel and the other in bf16 on exllamav3 over a 5120-window panel. Making the teacher a record with a panel_ref means a measurement that names a reference has already named a panel, a stack and a precision, and a reference whose kind is dequantized_from_quant (e.g. FP8 dequantized, as used by the MLX author) can never be silently read as a BF16-teacher number.

artifact_ref.description: The weights the reference logits came from.

panel_ref.description: REQUIRED. Reference logits only exist over a panel. A measurement's panel_ref must equal this.

reference_kind.description: What the teacher actually IS. dequantized_from_quant means the reference distribution is itself a quantized model's, so student numbers against it are systematically SMALLER than against a true BF16 teacher and must never be ranked against native_* rows.

logits_dtype.description: Precision the teacher logits were STORED at. fp32 storage of a bf16 forward pass is fp32 here and bf16 in compute_dtype.

head_source.description: own_head = the teacher's own lm_head produced the logits. shared_head_artifact = hidden states were captured and a single named head applied to both sides (our replay protocol).

author.description: Who produced this capture. A third party's teacher capture reused by us is still theirs.

logits_available.description: Whether the reference logits/hidden states are retained and re-scorable by us. false means a number against this reference can never be re-derived, only re-run.

self_consistency.description: The floor: what this reference scores against a same-kind replay of itself on this panel. Cross-stack rows are only interpretable against this floor, so we record the pointer here.

allOf.description: A dequantized teacher must be an artifact that is itself marked dequantized, and must carry a comparability-affecting disclosure.
A shared-head capture must name the head it shared.
